metadata.description: Claude Code skills for indie hackers who do their own growth: product analytics, paid ads (ChatGPT, Apple Search Ads, TikTok), App Store metadata and ASO, AI UGC content, programmatic SEO.

plugins.name: posthog-growth
plugins.description: Map your PostHog funnel, investigate conversion drops with dashboards, events and session replays, and judge paid campaigns by real signups and customers.

plugins.name: paid-ads
plugins.description: Run ChatGPT Ads and Apple Search Ads from the terminal (status, reports, diagnosis, safe campaign creation) and drive TikTok Ads Manager in the browser, with spend always confirmed by you.

plugins.name: app-store
plugins.description: App Store listing as code: per-locale metadata checked, diffed and pushed through the App Store Connect API, ASO keyword research, screenshot set guidance.

plugins.name: ugc-content
plugins.description: AI UGC that doesn't look like AI: consistent personas, porting photoreal image prompts into your pipeline, 9:16 video ads rendered from HTML with image-to-video clips.

plugins.name: seo
plugins.description: Programmatic SEO internal linking decided by a near-free decision model, plus the method to run any massive yes/no classification with it.
